metric_notes.document: Document rank folds repeated chunks by document_id and uses normalized source-title substring matching. Host mismatch is diagnostic only.
metric_notes.gold_chunk: DEV evidence is a set of exact Cascade chunk IDs. Any/All and mean recall are legacy chunk-coverage diagnostics, not atomic claim Evidence Recall.
metric_notes.latency_ms: Client-observed latency from one complete run; p50/p95 use linear interpolation.
metric_notes.answer_changed: Exact answer-string change only; no LLM judge is invoked.
metric_notes.rank_changes: source_rank_changed means the expected document rank changed; chunk_rank_changes lists shared chunks whose final context rank changed.
